hints.title: Inversion Counting
hints.text: Every swap moves a black ball right and a white ball left. Each white ball ('0') must cross all black balls ('1') that appear before it.

hints.title: Accumulating Black Balls
hints.text: Track the count of '1's seen so far during a single left-to-right pass.

hints.title: Summing Swaps
hints.text: Whenever a '0' is encountered, add the current count of '1's to the answer.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating preceding black ball count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize inversion count property of adjacent transpositions.
